entries.title: Mind Over Magic
entries.definitive_edition: Mind Over Magic on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Mind Over Magic is a magic-school colony simulation by Sparkypants, published by Klei. The Windows Early Access release began December 14, 2023, with the full release on February 12, 2025 and Steam Workshop support. No console, Mac, or Linux release was found in this pass. Windows PC is the definitive archive route because it is the release platform and the only current route with Workshop support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release rather than an Early Access branch. Use Workshop only for optional mods, not the baseline archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC full release with Steam achievements and Workshop support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced gameplay platform in this pass and the full 1.0 route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content or alternate edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive-edition split was found; archive the full release rather than Early Access.
